claims.claim: An applicant must be a UK national (as one way of qualifying).
claims.note: The eligibility requirements listed (age 18+, UK diagnosis, 2 years living in affirmed gender, intention to continue) say nothing about nationality.

claims.claim: An applicant who is not a UK national must be permanently resident in the UK.
claims.quote: You might still be able to apply, but only if you meet all of the following requirements: you currently live in the UK
claims.note: The text requires current UK residence only for the route without a gender dysphoria diagnosis and says nothing about permanent residence or nationality for the main route.
